issue_context.title: Endpoint Slices for Windows Kube Proxy
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**: EndpointSlice support for Windows in Kube Proxy
**Why is this needed**: 
The EndpointSlice API allows Kubernetes to
* Support tens of thousands of backend endpoints in a single service on cluster with thousands of nodes.
* Leave room for foreseeable extension:
  * Support multiple IPs per pod
  * More endpoint states than Ready/NotReady
  *  Dynamic endpoint subsetting

See [EndpointSlice API Enhancement issue](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/752)

review_comments: May want to add some nil handling if `*svcPortName` is nil.
It is not expected to be nil as it is obtained from enumeration of the map. And  since it is passed to an internal function i skipped any validation.

I think it would be good to add some tests to cover EndpointSlice functionality. This is not a pretty example, but with the iptables proxier we have a test covering EndpointSlice usage all the way through to final iptables config that is computed: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/proxy/iptables/proxier_test.go#L2412-L2504

Maybe add something to make it clearer which field is not matching:

```suggestion
			t.Errorf("Unexpected value for hnsID, got: %v, expected %v", epInfo.hnsID, guid)
```
